newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - June 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - June 24.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Tuesday, as reported by Kyodo news agency.
-- Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto calls for world's united efforts to prevent global warming.
-- Local government bond issuance to be liberalised.
-- Poll shows 51 percent call for acceleration of administrative reform.
-- 41 deaths linked to high-calorie intravenous feeding.
-- South Koeran President Kim Young-sam urges Prime Minister Hashimoto to coordinate with South Korea and United States over food aid to North Korea.
